name: s18-resp-mcp-http
config:
[[permissions]]
tool = "apply_patch"
pattern = "*"
decision = "allow"
[[permissions]]
tool = "run_command"
pattern = "python -m pytest*"
decision = "allow"
[[permissions]]
tool = "mcp__tracker__get_issue"
pattern = "*"
decision = "allow"
[[permissions]]
tool = "read_mcp_resource"
pattern = "tracker *"
decision = "allow"
[mcp_servers.tracker]
url = "http://127.0.0.1:{MCPPORT}/mcp"
bearer_token_env_var = "TRACKER_TOKEN"

args: Work on ISSUE-7 from the tracker. Read the tracker's contributing guidelines first, and follow them.
Which issues does the tracker list as resources? Answer from the tracker only.
